roles.title: Secretary of the Interior
roles.source_excerpt: Doug Burgum, the 55th U.S. Secretary of the Interior, is a North Dakota native whose career spans entrepreneurship, technology and public service. After working his way through North Dakota State University and earning an MBA from Stanford, he mortgaged farmland to invest in Great Plains Software, which he led to a successful IPO and eventual acquisition by Microsoft. He later co-founded Arthur Ventures and chaired several global tech firms.
